name: Single-cell multi-omics prediction and integration benchmark
description: A benchmark suite measuring the accuracy and integration quality of algorithms that predict and integrate multiple single-cell omics modalities (e.g., RNA, ATAC, protein).
evaluation_method: task-specific_metrics (e.g., Pearson/Spearman correlation, AUROC, ARI, NMI, F1) / composite_score
reputation: Used within the single-cell computational biology community as a useful suite for benchmarking multi-omics integration and prediction methods, though adoption is primarily domain-specific.
notes: Domain-specific, non-LLM benchmark; results are sensitive to preprocessing, batch-correction, and experimental variation; multiple heterogeneous metrics make cross-method comparison dependent on chosen aggregation.
